_readme: Hand-maintained fixes for data/sources/wikidata-events.json, applied by scripts/build-data.mjs. 'dates' overrides a start (s) or end (e) date where Wikidata has a clear typo; each entry says why. Dates use the same format as events.json: '1877-01-29', '1877' or '-0229' for 229 BC. Consider fixing the item on Wikidata too.

Q154552.why: Illyro-Roman Wars were 229–168 BC; Wikidata has the years as AD.

Q714820.why: Satsuma Rebellion began 29 January 1877; Wikidata has 2005.

Q1187198.why: Ten Tragic Days were 9–19 February 1913; Wikidata has the end as 1910.
